text: |-|XC3 = |-|FR = Jalapenokis are Mushroom Collectible items in and . They can be found in the Fornis Region in . They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator, or the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. In , they can be found on the Aurora Shelf. They can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).
Jagron Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossilized Jagrons.
Jaggy Pecans are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Kelp Namekos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Keves Blockers () are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 14-15 in Bennel Cave and the Gorge of Odie in the Eagus Wilderness during Chapter 2, and at level 60-62 on Everblight Plain and Captocorn Peak.

Keves Blocker Elites () are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 62 on Everblight Plain, on Captocorn Peak, or in Erythia Sea. Their levels are dependent on the Keves Warning Level.
Jarack Vvargas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Vvarga family, and can be found at level 69-70 in the Fuschian Fields of Millick Meadows.

Jarack Volffs are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 53-54 on Captocorn Peak in the Aetia Region. They may drop legendary Volffskin, which is needed for the gem Refined Blessing X. One is fought at level 70 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Men! Of! The Sea! IV.
Kattl Krammits are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Krammit family, and can be found at level 21-22 at Dumas' Jaw on the Rae-Bel Tableland.

Keves Blasters () are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 14 in Bennel Cave in the Eagus Wilderness, level 21 in the Urayan Tunnels, level 46 on the Urayan Trail, and level 62 on Elaice Highway.

Keves Warrior Elites (Japanese: , Kevesu Hai Wōria) are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 21 in the Urayan Tunnels, level 47 at the Cradle Convoy Shelter at the Great Sword's Base, and level 62 on Elaice Highway.
Jurass Blants are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Blant family, and can be found at level 95 in the Cavern of Oblivion in Low Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region.
Jazz Engines are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Jet Breccias are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Jade Corals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Jade Lobsters are items in . They can be produced from any Fabricator except the one at Perimeter Outlet.
Kananus Razor Horns are items in . They are dropped from Eruno Kananuses.

Kerfluffled Torpedo Wraps are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It can be unlocked by purchasing the Mixed-Veg Torpedo Wrap from the Colony 4 Canteen for the first time.
Kanbat Rhoguls are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 45 on the Great Sword's Hilt.
Kef Stamms are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 62-63 at Amplifier No. 1, Amplifier No. 2, and the Amplifier Section in the Origin Interior.
Kef Zestamms are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 63 at Amplifier No. 1 and Amplifier No. 2: Lower Gate in the Origin Interior.
Kanbat Ansels are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 42-43 at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region.
Javelin Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 44-97 in Erythia Sea.
Javelin Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 44-48 & 72 in Erythia Sea.
Kassis Plambuses are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Plambus family, and can be found at level 72 on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea.

Keves Warriors (Japanese: , Kevesu Wōria) are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 14-15 in the Gorge of Odie and Bennel Cave in Eagus Wilderness during Chapter 2, and at level 30 in Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region.
Jail Blasters (Japanese: , Jeiru Faia) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Jail Duoblades (Japanese: , Jeiru Asaruto) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54-55 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Jail Medics (Japanese: , Jeiru Medikku) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54-55 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Jail Scouts (Japanese: , Jeiru Sukauto) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54-55 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Jail Skirmishers (Japanese: , Jeiru Rasshu) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54-55 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Jail Vanguards (Japanese: , Jeiru Bangādo) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are Agnus Soldiers, and can be found at level 54-55 at Li Garte Prison Camp during In Search of a Home.
Kaalm Garaffas are three Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family, and are fought at level 48 in the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp during Third Day of Prison.

Jango is an NPC in . He was part of Lenny's squad alongside Olivia-Anne and Marlon before being killed by monsters in Yzana Plains. Noah sends him and his fallen comrades off during the quest Farewell Melody. __NOTOC__
Jhodor (Japanese: , Jodou) is an NPC in who can be found in Agnus Castle.
Kanata (Japanese: , Kanata) is a NPC in . Kanata is from Colony Mu.
The Keen Beak is a Key Item in . It is dropped by the Towaris Taos during Jeremy's Request.
Kevesi Infantry Exosuits are Key Items in . They can be found around Everblight Plain and at the Gura Flava Lowlands in Alfeto Valley during Lean Times in Colony 9.
The Jeweled Pebble is a Key Item in . It is a rare pebble dropped by the Lavi Pagul during Romero and Joulietta.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Jewel Beetle Gauntlets are Accessories in and . The legendary variant can be acquired from Dreadwyrm Nizoont. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Stronghammer Dorga.

Keves Sniper Elites (Japanese: , Kevesu Haishūtā) are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 15-60 at Yzana Plains in the Aetia Region, or at Urayan Trail in the Pentelas Region, or at Syra Hovering Reefs in the Keves Castle Region.
Keves Snipers () are Minor Enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 14-15 in Bennel Cave in the Eagus Wilderness during Colony 4's attack, and at level 47 on the Urayan Trail.

Keves Forces are enemies in and . They are various soldiers from the nation of Keves encountered throughout Aionios. They will appear more often and at higher levels the higher the Keves Warning Level is. They can occasionally be found fighting against Agnus Forces.
This page lists all the quests available in the Keves Castle Region.
Kallow Aries are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Aries family, and can be found at level 65 on Piula Path on Captocorn Peak.
Karorii Ories are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ories family, and can be found at level 65 on Piula Path on Captocorn Peak.
The Itiya Darbus is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Darbus family, and is fought at level 55 on Piula Path on Captocorn Peak during The Big, Unseen Monster.
Keves Rescuer Elites () are enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 21 in Dannagh Desert, or at Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region.

Keves Trooper Elites (Japanese: , Kevesu Hai Sorujā) are enemies in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 15 in Bennel Cave in the Eagus Wilderness during Chapter 2, and at level 30 in Erythia Sea.
Ix, also known as No. 6, is a NPC in . Ix is a member of Colony 0 and can be found at Li Garte Prison Camp after In Search of a Home. He is an Agnian human with Urayan traits.

Jumbo Tirkin is an NPC in who can be found at Ag's Talon on Elaice Highway during Knowing Your Family. He is an unusually large Tirkin who is the father of Mini Tirkin and Micro Tirkin. After being followed by Ghondor and the party, he asks the party to collect some food for him and his children. However, Colony 29 Raiders attack while the party is away, and while the party is able to drive the attackers away, Jumbo Tirkin unfortunately passes away from his injuries. Before passing away, Jumbo Tirkin asks Ghondor to look after his tirklets.
Keves Deathsappers are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Keves Soldiers, and can be found at level 60 in the Low Maktha Wildwood during Past and Present.

The Keves Armadillo is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a Kevesi Levnis made from an Agnian Armadillo that is sent to Colony Iota from Colony 30 by Valdi as a gift, but upon arrival it attacks the colony due to a mistake. It is fought at level 68 at the Colony Iota Base Entrance on Elaice Highway during Bearing Fruit. Similarly to all of Valdi's other creations, he gave it the nickname of "Cyberchum".

Kaleidoscopic Core is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track nineteen of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track nineteen of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is a remix of Drifting Soul from . This song plays in battle when Nia is the active Hero if the "Special BGM" setting is enabled.

The Kevesi Ferronis is a Boss in . It is a Ferronis fused with the Colony Eta Ferronis by W, and is fought at level 19 at the Diablada Cliffs on the Aurora Shelf. Both it and the Agnian Ferronis must be defeated in order to damage Moebius W.
Jilljill is a Nopon NPC in . She can be found at the Elevator Landing Camp on the Aurora Shelf. Her Community is gained when talking to her after completing Elevator Repairs.
Keves Patrollers are five Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Keves Soldiers that are fought at level 40-41 near the Gelgemos Garrison on The Ragmos Desolation during Regret and Resolve.
Jethro is an NPC in . He can be found in Colony 9. Jethro's Community is gained when talking to him after completing Step by Step and then talking with him twice.

Kayleigh is an NPC in . She is a former Keves soldier who now works as part of the Liberators in Colony 9. Kayleigh's Community is gained when talking to her after completing Where Is That Guy?, changing Harby's Community status, and talking with her twice.

Keves Emblems are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Kevesi Standards, and can be found at level 36 around the Keves Outpost at the Colony 22, 7th Platoon Camp in Vermilion Woods. They drop rare Emblem Adornments.
Joggyjoggy's Amulet - Silver is a Key Item in . It is received from Bobobi during Nopon Medals Needed.
Joggyjoggy's Amulet - Gold is a Key Item in . It is received from Bobobi during Nopon Medals Needed.

Keves Colony is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twelve of disc three from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track twelve of disc fourteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the day in Kevesi colonies after Chapter 2.
Joyful Pippitos are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family that can be found during the Archsage's Gauntlet during the Lucky Monster event.
Joyful Ottils are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Ottil family that can be found during the Archsage's Gauntlet during the Lucky Monster event.

Katchafish DXs are two Key Items in . They are two fishing tools designed by Bartholomew and built by Vredda during Hook, Line and Sinker. One must be brought to Bartholomew, while the other is kept by the party. Upon the quest's completion, the Katchafish DX unlocks new collection points at Tranquil Tarn.
Kelemen is a NPC in . He oversees weapon research and development at Grenada Galactic Group.
Kato is a NPC in . He can be found at North Founders Street in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
Jammer Familivs are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Familiv family, and can be found at level 59 inside the Tower of Eternity on Volitaris after being summoned by Void.
Kaelith is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in the Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Jungle Rumble is a Nopon Grand Prix Score Attack Course in . It takes place in Makna Forest in the evening. This course starts on the eastern end of Bridge One and finishes at the Decayed Forest.
The Junk was an Important Item in . It was intended to be obtained from the wreckage of Zu Pharg in Sylvalum.
Kaizar is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at the Uraya Merc Barracks in Fonsa Myma, Uraya.

Jovial Saltats (Japanese: , Gāra Sarutāto, Gala Saltat) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family. Five of them are found at level 13-15 at Sunlit Spring in Noctilum during A Proper Chopper.
Katars are spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Viragos or white Puges.

Kneecap Rocks (Japanese: , Shitsugai Ganban) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to their description, they are rough rocks that yield a golden building material when polished. Two are required for Collection Quest 1 in Tephra Cave, and one more for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 6,700 Noponstones.
Kilaki (Japanese: , Kika) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found on the Archaeology Level in Frontier Village.

King Squeeze (Japanese: , Kingu Sukuizu) is a Homs in . He can be found northwest of the Gem Man's Stall on the second floor in Colony 9. He is a loan shark in Colony 9, and is in league with Sylviane to make Leopold spend all his money on her, making it impossible to pay off his debt to King Squeeze. King Squeeze plans to take Leopold's house as payment and retire. During the quests An Impoverished Critic and Financial Planning, if the A route (talk to Leopold) is chosen, King Squeeze will disappear so it will be impossible to meet him again in the same playthrough.

Kiroki (Japanese: , Kiroro) is a Nopon in . He can be found in the Refugee Camp, and later in Colony 6. During A Selfish Girl's Mistake, he can be found in the Drainage Control Room in the Ether Mine.
Kokora (Japanese: , Kirara) is a Nopon in . She can be found wandering near the Nopon Tower in Frontier Village during the day.
Kuriku (Japanese: , Kyuri) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found in the western portion of the Central Plaza in Frontier Village.
Kofuko (Japanese: , Fugofugo) is a Nopon in . He can be found in the armour shop in the western portion of the Central Plaza in Frontier Village.
Lalapa (Japanese: , Rapan) is a Nopon in . He can be found at the Chief's Residence in Frontier Village.

Lar'shen (Japanese: , Chāruzu, Charles) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. He can be found at the bottom of the northern staircase in the Great Hall in Alcamoth, opposite from Galdo, from 18:00 to 06:00. He occupies the same post as Lecrough. After the events of Mechonis Core, Rozeal reveals that when the Bionis reawakened, he was killed trying to protect the survivors so they could escape from the Telethia.

※ After this quest is completed, Lupa may offer Mystery of Makna Ruins 1. Kind Lupa's Grampypon (Japanese: , Tamani wa Mago Rashiku) is a quest in . It can be received from Lupa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. Once Kind Lupa's Grampypon is accepted, Secret Elixir Ingredients is automatically triggered.

Large Mangoes (Japanese: , Mushimangō, Bug Mango) are collectables in . They can be found on the Fallen Arm and Colony 6. According to their description, they attract bugs and they are too bitter for people to eat anyway.

Lake Magdalena (Japanese: , Komen no Magudarēna) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Sardi family, and can be found under a small inlet under Outlook Park in Colony 9 at night, usually accompanied by two Pawn Piranhax. Defeating this enemy is required to complete Challenge 3.

Krabbles (Japanese: , Kuraibu; English dub: ) are a common species of enemy which look similar to hermit crabs in the . They are similar in appearance to Paguls and Krammits. Krabbles are found near water and undergo no appearance change between games.
Lancelot Armour is medium torso armour in . It is the result of the best Homs, Nopon, and High Entia minds working together.

Kyn Shopping Street (Japanese: , Kaina Shōten-dōri) is a location in . It is located on the first floor of Frontier Village. It is a shopping street, as the name suggests, and a number of shops are seen here. However, the only one the party can actually purchase from is the Frontier Village Weapon Shop. The party is required to go to this shop when Riki is first met, to get him a weapon before they go to defeat the "Dinobeast".

Kneecap Hill (Japanese: , Hizagashira no Oka) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of Tephra Cave, and is a small grassy plateau at the Bionis' Leg entrance to Tephra Cave. When Shulk and Reyn first arrive here, a short cutscene is shown in which they look at Mechonis. After this, they turn around and climb up some vines on a wall that lead up to Leg Pass, and from there the Bionis' Leg. There is a Heart-to-Heart here - "A Scene Revisited" - and A Thank You requires an item (a Topple Resist gem) to be retrieved from here.

Lake Flamiis are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 7 near Anti-Air Battery 1 in Colony 9. Defeating two of them is required to complete the quest Monster Quest 2 - Part 1, and they can drop the Yolkless Flamii Egg needed for Material Quest 4.

Kisk Cave (Japanese: , Kisuku Dōkutsu) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. It is a cave which leads to an elevated area where some Tirkins are found. There is also a Key Item here, the Bird Necklace, which is required for Search Quest 1. On the map, it is located south of Viliera Hill; however, its only entrance is actually east of the entrance to the Refugee Camp. Inside the cave is an Ether Deposit. During Earnest's Fibs, Earnest tells the party that the Ether Deposit inside is everlasting. However, when it is examined, the party is attacked by a group of Vangs.
Lancelot Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They are the result of the best Homs, Nopon, and High Entia minds working together. They can be dropped by Obart Obarts.
Lancelot Leggings are medium legs armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies.

King Agni's Tomb (Japanese: , Seifuku-ō Agini no Funbo) is a Secret Area in . It is located in Makna Forest, near the Pod Landing Site, and southwest from Valak Pass. Initially, the tomb is sealed, preventing the party from going further than the entrance. However, a line of quests from Lupa — a Nopon in Frontier Village who can be found around the metal hut on the Archaeology Level — allows access to the inside of the tomb. She is interested in the tomb and the Giants, thinking there is some sort of connection, and she sends the party to check it out for her. Three Ancient Documents must be obtained to open the tomb, which is sealed. Once the tomb is opened, the doors open and i
Knuckle Bunnits (Japanese: , Nakkuru Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family. They can be found on the upper part of Tephra Hill in Colony 9.
Lancelot Gear (Japanese: , Ransurotto Gia) is medium head armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies.

The Lake Drop is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required to complete Imaginations Tempered, and is also one of the two choices that can be given to Matryona to complete Matryona's Answer. It can be found just north of the Tranquil Grotto on Bionis' Leg, which is in the southeast of Raguel Lake. The Lake Drop can only be obtained once; if it is used to complete Imaginations Tempered, the series of quests What is Love?!, What is Courage?!, and Matryona's Answer will be unavailable. Giving Matryona the Lake Drop will produce the Beautiful Portrait. It is possible to get the Lake Drop during Imaginations Tempered, to complete Spirits Raised instead, and later to use the already collec

Knuckle Drivers (Japanese: , Nakkurubankā) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be bought from two shops or dropped by mechon in Sword Valley and Galahad Fortress.

King Clusters (Japanese: , Kingukurasutā) are weapons in . They are rifles wielded by Sharla. They can be obtained as a quest reward, in a trade with Bokoko who can be found in Satorl Marsh, as well as a drop from enemies in Satorl Marsh and Colony 6.

The King Frog (Japanese: , Kingufuroggu) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of Riki's biters, and can be dropped by the Shimmering Forte. They can be acquired by purchasing them at the Syrath Lighthouse Shop at Eryth Sea for 24,300 G. They can also be acquired by trading with Jer'ell who can be found in Satorl Marsh.

The Khatorl Staff (Japanese: , Shimai Tsue Katōru) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a staff and is usable by Melia. It can be acquired by trading with Migaga who can be found in Frontier Village.

Lagoon Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are worn by Dickson, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Although classified as medium armour, it has the same icon as most light arms armour, including Colony Cuffs and Nine Cuffs.

Lagoon Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are worn by Dickson, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Although classified as medium armour, they have the same icon as most light feet armour including Colony Shoes and Nine Shoes.
Lancelot Boots are medium feet armour in . They are available for sale at Colony 6 Shop 8 and can be dropped by various enemies.

Lagoon Gear (Japanese: , Ragūn Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is worn by Dickson, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Although classified as medium armour, it has the same icon as most light headgear, including Colony Cap and Nine Cap.

Lagoon Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are worn by Dickson, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Although classified as medium armour, it has the same icon as most light legs armour, including Colony Bottoms and Nine Bottoms.

The Lakeside (Japanese: , Kyūsoku no Kishibe) is a landmark in . It is located in Makna Forest, on the lake's north shore below and west of the Agni Tablet. This is where Shulk encounters Telethia for the first time, and initially meets Alvis. Alvis teaches Shulk another Monado art, Monado Purge, which seals the aura of Telethia. There is a water Ether Deposit here that is visited in the story quest Mystery Girl Rescue.

Lakebed Orthlus (Japanese: , Kotei no Ofuresu) is a quest exclusive Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Torta family, and can be found at level 40 on the beach of Agora Shore outside Colony 9 during Preparing for Adventure 3 and before reaching the Mechonis Core. It is sight aggressive and it drops the Orthlus' Liver that is required to complete this quest.

Krabble Back Mosses are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Oros Krabbles on the Fallen Arm, and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are mosses often found in small quantities and their saltiness goes well with rice. Five lots of it are needed to complete the quest Save the Machina!.
Kilaki's Note is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Kilaki in Frontier Village as a reward for completing Heropon's Spirit, and is required for opening the gate to the Hode Lair.

Laeklit Mammuts are minor enemies in . They are the only members of the Mammut family, and can be found at level 96 just north of the Village Entrance in Makna Forest. They are the only source of the Mammut Horn required for the Replica Monado 4 quest.
Lariat (Japanese: , Rariatto, English dub: ) is one of Reyn's physical arts in . It damages enemies in a frontal arc. Each enemy hit increases Reyn's talent gauge by 25%. In , Nene can use this art.

Lagoon Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is worn by Dickson, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Although classified as medium armour, it has the same icon as most light torso armour including Colony Top and Nine Top.

Largo Seluas (Japanese: , Rārugo Serura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Selua family, and can be found at levels 72 to 73 in the First, Second, and Third Lungs in Bionis' Interior. They drop the Flexible Selua Cells needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Krabble Fixed Parts are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by Junk Krabbles in the Ether Mine, or traded for during route A of What is Courage?! with Ewan. According to their description, they are parts repaired by Krabbles that get childish notions to fix things. Two are needed for route B of Out Like a Light?.

Lacus Flamiis (Japanese: , Rakusu Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 24 around the Altar of Fate in Satorl Marsh anytime but with no fog. They can drop the Twin Flamii Eggs needed for Preventing Starvation.

Krabble Artworks are rare materials in . It can be dropped by Krabbles in Colony 9, or traded for with Zukazu. According to their description, they are pieces of artwork crafted over a lifetime that house the soul of a Krabble. Two are needed for Désirée's Apology.

Lancer Tirkins (Japanese: , Ransā Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found from level 15-20 on Bionis' Leg northwest of Kasharpa Falls. They can drop the Tirkin Crests needed for Material Quest 2.

Lahar Flamiis (Japanese: , Rahāru Furamī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 73 at night on the Bionis' Leg, in the marshes west of Spiral Valley and along the shore of the unnamed ponds north-east and south-west of Jabos Rock.
Last Rhoguls (Japanese: , Rasuto Rōguru) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 76 near the Zax Guidepost and Crevasse Waterfall on Bionis' Leg.

Klanis Apis are enemies in . They are members of the Apis family, and can be found at level 28 near the Divine Sanctuary, Lakeside, and Bridge Two in Makna Forest. They can drop the Royal Apis Nectar needed for one route of Popularity Premonition.

Kurian Hodes (Japanese: , Kurian Fūdi) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hode family, and can be found at level 35 in the Eryth Sea. They drop Luxury Hode Wood, three pieces of which are needed for the quest Mend the Plant.

Kukukoro Flamiis (Japanese: , Kukukoro Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found on the Fallen Arm. Like most Flamii, they can be found near beaches such as Jifum Beach. They can drop the Pretty Flamii Legs needed for I Want to be a Homs!

The Large Mechon Store (Japanese: , Ōgata Kishinpei Kanri Sōko) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of the Central Factory. The M97 Commander, who drops the Ether Explosive needed for Materials for a Bomb, can be found here, along with the Synchronised Gaheris.

Krabble Detergents are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only dropped by Corriente Krabbles on the Fallen Arm, or be traded for with Theo, Bozatrox, or Natalia. According to their description, they are detergent foams that are stored in the bodies of five-year old Krabbles.
Landing Strip 2 (Japanese: , Kishin-kō Dai-2 Hatchakuba) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of the Central Factory, opposite Landing Strip 1. The Mild Florence can be found here.
Landing Strip 1 (Japanese: , Kishin-kō Dai-1 Hatchakuba) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of the Central Factory, opposite Landing Strip 2.
Krabble Stones are rare materials in . They can be dropped by various Krabbles or be traded for.

Kindred Enemies are a type of enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles that automatically join in a battle with nearby enemies of their same species. Unlike sight-based or sound-based enemies, a monster's status as a Kindred Enemy is separate to their detection type, and does not depend on their level nor does it depend on said detection type. A kindred sight-based monster will always join in on a nearby battle, even if the party was not in their line of sight. Likewise, if the party initiates a battle with an enemy ten levels lower than themselves, all nearby kindred enemies will join the fight, even though they would never challenge the party on their own at this level. Kind Words (Japanese: , Yasashii Kimochi) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located west of the Terminal Nerve Tower in the Bionis' Interior, between Melia and Riki at pink affinity.

Lake Terebras (Japanese: , Reiku Rutoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Terebra family, and can be found at level 1-10 at Biahno Lake or at Sayram Lake in Primordia. They have a distinctive ear-piercing screech.

Knives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. In the beginning of the game, this is the initial melee weapon Cross can use as a Drifter. Knives are retained when changing to Enforcer, and can be further mastered through Psycorruptor and Mastermind Classes. Knives are also the melee weapons used by Irina, Celica, Hope, and Mia.

L'cirufe (Japanese: , Ru Shirufe; English dub: ), commonly known as L (Japanese: , Rū; English dub: ), is one of the eight main playable characters in . He is an inventor indigenous to Mira who sells his crafts to the Nopon and other natives in exchange for food. He gives his occupation as "Wanderer". Although he is not a member of BLADE, he assists their field operatives from time to time.
La Mancha (Japanese: , Ra Mancha) is an area in . It is located to the east of North Janpath Plain in Primordia, connecting the region to Oblivia.

Lao Huang (Japanese: , Rao; English dub: ) is one of the eight main playable characters in . He is the leader of the Pathfinder Team Belisarda (English dub: ) of the private military organization BLADE. Lao has been Doug's comrade-in-arms since their days in the United States Army. He has a mutual deep relationship with Lin, who shares a similar past.

Lailah is a Medium Type based Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Lailah is one of the Skells used by BLADE in New Los Angeles. The Lailah vehicle is a custom Medium vehicle, a sort of futuristic armed machine.

Lake Falsaxums (Japanese: , Reiku Garukasu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Falsaxum family, and can be found at level 27-30 near FN Site 302, North Coast, and Barbarich Desert in Oblivia.

Kun'luarb (Japanese: , Kun'eibu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean, and first meets the party in Noctilum during Rescue at the Ensconced Citadel. In New Los Angeles, he can be found near Ishmael Hills in the Residential District.
Langul, the Alien Payload (Japanese: , Iseijin Kakudantō Rangure) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Cavern Clan Prone and can be found at level 11 in Seaswept Base.

Lake Mortifoles (Japanese: , Reiku Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family and can be found at level 11-12 at Rustpool Banks, Old Dragontail Tree, or Potter's Rock in Noctilum. Five of them must be defeated to complete the Basic Mission Mortifole Mulching. They drop Golden Mortifole Feathers, two of which are required for the Basic Mission Indigen Investigation.

Lambert, the Divine Wind (Japanese: , Kamikaze no Ranbāto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Insidia family and can be found at level 15 at Goblin's Narrow in Noctilum. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Lambert, the Divine Wind.
Kirsty (Japanese: , Kāsuti) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is the FrontierNav operations manager.
Kite Turbas (Japanese: , Kaito Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 43-44 at Decapotamon or near FN Site 212 in Noctilum.

Knight Pugiliths (Japanese: , Naito Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 32-36 near South Silent Sandsea (on the western part of the broken land bridge), Badr Stonebridge, outside of Hilal Stronghold, and west of FN Site 416 in Sylvalum.

Knight Puges (Japanese: , Naito Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 32-36 at Lesser Anvil, Badr Stonebridge, South Cinderdunes, and Hilal Stronghold in Sylvalum. Defeating six of them is required during the mission Pounding Puges.
Killing Machine is one of many Aura Arts in . It increases the user's melee accuracy, melee attack, and potential stats.
Last Words is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when the party member is incapacitated.
Killshot is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Partisan Eagle at rank 2. Cross, Bozé and Lao can use this skill.

Koko (Japanese: , Kaka, English dub: ) is an NPC in . She is a Nopon and can be found in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum. She is met during the mission The Ties That Bind. She is Tatsu's mother and the leader of the Dodonga Caravan.
Lapis Scirpos (Japanese: , Rapisu Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Scirpos and can be found at level 12 in Headwater Cavern in Primordia.
Lark Turbas (Japanese: , Rāku Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 33 in Noctilum, near FN Site 217.

Lara Nara (Japanese: , Rāra Nāra) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the BLADE Tower or at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, then at Repenta Diner in the Industrial District. He is Lara Mara's twin brother. He is a member of the Mediators Division.

Laser Raptor Seidr (Japanese: , Rēzāraputā Basugia) are mechanoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Seidr of Ganglion's origin. They can be found at level 44-45 in the skies around FN Site 505, Sunset Falls, and Kitsune Stronghold in Cauldros.

Lake Diluses (Japanese: , Reiku Kurogosu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Dilus family. They can be found at level 26-30 at River Isle or Lake Basel in Oblivia. They drop Amber Dilus Eyes, one of which is needed for The Carrot.

Land Gerrids (Japanese: , Rando Girafa) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Gerrid family. They can be found at level 50 in Adder Byroad and FN Site 506 in Cauldros. They are much, much larger than normal gerrids, being taller than even a Skell.

Kvass Scirpos (Japanese: , Kuwasu Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 41-42 in Hardheart Canyon in Sylvalum during the day.

Lake Ciel (Japanese: , Shieru-ko) is an area in . It is located in Sylvalum, north of the Needle Rock Sandsea. It is surrounded by four sandseas, each named for its relative location to the lake (East Ciel Sandsea, West Ciel Sandsea, South Ciel Sandsea, and North Ciel Sandsea). FN Site 408 and FN Site 411 are located here. A long sandbar running north to south splits the lake in two. In terms of overall surface area, the combined eastern and western branches of Lake Ciel are the largest lake on the surface of Mira. However, the lake as a whole is also extremely shallow, and can indeed be walked or run across from end to end without needing to swim. Among the lake's inhabitants, the most prom

The Lakeview Stronghold (Japanese: , Kojō Yōsai) is an area in . It is located in Noctilum, southwest of Waterway Tangle. It is a Prone base. All Prone in this area are kindred enemies, and the entire base's inhabitants will attack if one detects the party.

Kringe, the Hunting Arrow (Japanese: , Satsuya no Kuringe) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Caro family. It can be found at level 40 at Scholes Battlegrounds in Cauldros, on the land bridge connecting Scholes Battlegrounds and Titan's Table. It must be defeated for Squad Mission No.11.

Kiran Catnips (English dub: , Japanese: , Kiranmatatabi) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular at FN Site 103. Three Kiran Catnips are needed to complete the Affinity Mission Nine Lives.

King's Falls (Japanese: , Kingusu Fōru) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the largest waterfall in Oblivia, flowing down from the Ruins on the Sandbank to the main river. Dart and Gi Ziordo can be found here during Serial Thriller and Two Warriors respectively. It must also be visited during Search Request (Oblivia).
Land Caecuses (Japanese: , Rando Doren) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caecus family, and can be found at level 42 north of Ternion Fork in Cauldros.
L's Conundrum (Japanese: , Rū no Nayami) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received at the eastern end of Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Lacey Potatoes (Japanese: , Rēshī Imo) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Ten of them are needed for Cooking Schooled.

L-002 Fuel Tanks (Japanese: , L-002 Nenryō Tanku) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular at FN Site 112. Two are required for the Normal Mission Better Latte Than Never.
Kusakiri Stag Beetles (Japanese: , Kusakirikuwagata) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.
L-002 Dagoo Heat Rays (Japanese: , L-002 Kansai Nessenbō Dagoo) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Lake Papils (Japanese: , Reiku Papirio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Papil family, and can be found at level 11 at Biahno River and Green Threshold in Primordia at daytime. Seven must be defeated to completed for the Basic Mission Papil Punisher.

Kyatara Onions (Japanese: , Kyatara Tamanegi) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular on the Slavebird Isle near FN Site 507. Fifteen are required for A Spot of Gardening.

Lantern Petramands (Japanese: , Rantan Aranea, Lanthanum Petramand) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 38-40 in the Den of the Dead in Sylvalum.
Land Monoceros (Japanese: , Rando Unikoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Monoceros family, and can be found at level 41-42 north of Kitsune Stronghold in Cauldros.
Laser Lights are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Deva Caladar in Sylvalum. They can also be bought for 66 Reward Tickets each in the Network Console.

The Kw'arah Cloister (Japanese: , Ku-Ara Shūdōku) is an Unexplored Territory in . It is located in Cauldros on the cliffs west of FN Site 515, below the Kw'arah Villa, and can be reached by taking the south path from the M'gando Gorge BC. The FN Site 514 is here. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("The Glorious Kw'arah Cloister").

Kitsune Stronghold (Japanese: , Tenko no Yōsai) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion base located in Cauldros at the FN Site 512. It can be approached either from the T'phnom Shelf or Tengu's Playground.
Lask, the Unscrupulous (Japanese: , Akuratsu no Rasuku) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Mephite family. It can be found at level 48 at Gehenna Span in Sylvalum.

Latis, the Bristle-Scaled (, Gekirin no Ratisu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Tersqual family. It can be found at level 39 by the watering hole at North Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum.

The Keycard is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Yardley asks the party to find it in House of Cards. The Keycard can be found on the Administrative District's lower level, behind a stack of large cargo containers on the raised area west of the Restricted Hangar Entrance.

Lake Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Reiku Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 44-45 in the lake within Behemoth's Shadows in Sylvalum.

Lake Visigels (Japanese: , Reiku Narukī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Visigel family, and can be found at level 31-33 in Sylvalum on the western side of the land strip bisecting Lake Ciel.

Lakeside Getaway (Japanese: , Reikusaido Bakansu) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received by talking to Rosie on Water Purification Plant in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. The Keycard is obtained after defeating the Raging Cantor and the Ian's ID Card can be found on its body. Ajoa's ID Card can be obtained after defeating Ajoa Cantor if the A route has been chosen. By completing this mission, "The Biahno Tragedy" achievement will also be rewarded.
LV757: Lyvia (Japanese: , LV757: Rivia) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian and appears in Oblivia, where the party battles her.

L's Bodywear is a casual full body armor in and . It is part of L's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means. It can only be equipped by male characters, and it has the same appearance on all of them. It shares its appearance with the Supercivilization Attire.
Knock 'n' Shock is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Partisan Eagle at rank 7.

Lance Puges (Japanese: , Ransu Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 41-50 in Oblivia, near the edge of the Yawning Giant north of FN Site 307.

Kon'luarb (Japanese: , Kon'eibu) is an NPC in ' and . He is an Orphean and can be initially found at the Deck of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. He can be found later near the Deliverance Park in the Residential District, then at Ishmael Hills at nighttime.

Lara Mara (Japanese: , Rāra Mēra) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, then at Repenta Diner in the Industrial District. He is Lara Nara's twin brother.
Kuta (Japanese: , Kutta) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the night.
Kiefer Cole (Japanese: , Kiasu Kōru, English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. He is Leland Cole's son.
King's Decree is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Psycorruptor at rank 5. Cross, Irina and Hope can use this skill.
King's Boon is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Mastermind at rank 9. Cross and Irina can use this skill.
Knight's Soul is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Blast Fencer at rank 5.
Large Purgovent Livers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Purgovents.
Lana is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found near East Melville Street in New Los Angeles. If route B is chosen during My Angel, My Lana, she moves to the Drongo Caravan in Cauldros.

The Ladha Caladar (Japanese: , Gu Rada) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the Caladar Skell piloted by Gu Ladha. It is fought at level 38 on Primordia's Unicorn Rock during Route B of Lend an Ear.
Kupee (Japanese: , Kupyi) is an NPC in . She can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the day.
The Kuta's Cargo is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be retrieved during Castle in the Sky from the Jacul Ire at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum.

Lan'cord (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean who is first mentioned during the Normal Mission Haywire!, and is encountered later at Lake Basel in Oblivia during Murderess's Affinity Mission The Little Rich Girl.
Large Lophid Livers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lophids.

The Lachesis Puge (Japanese: , Rakeshisu Berude) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Puge machine, Ganglion's human size robot, and can be found at level 28 at Bandits' Refuge in Cauldros. Defeating it is required during Rites of Ruin.
Large Saw Teeth are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cetos.
Kidnapped: Uzoma Vassago (Japanese: , Uzoma Vasago) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sevvy Belgazus in the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Kidnapped: Oll Valdileo (Japanese: , Oru Barudireo) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sevvy Belgazus in the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Kidnapped: Rada Valdileo (Japanese: , Rada Barudireo) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sevvy Belgazus in the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Kitty Chow is L's third Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is available if the current pet in the BLADE Barracks is a cat. It occurs between L and Cross on a front lawn southwest of the Residential District's Cathedral.
Lab Rat Run is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a medical researcher and the primary destination is Oblivia.

The Last Galdr (Japanese: , Rasuto Garudora) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 50 Galdr machine, and is encountered during Snipe Hunt. It is first seen above Primordia's Talon Rock Third Terrane, and must be fought later above Primordia's Bedrock Hold.
Kopopo (Japanese: , Kopopo) is an NPC in . He is a Nopon found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Knife III Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Knife. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Line of Fire. The Knife III weapons available in-game are: * Carbide Knife III * Cermet Knife III * Chrome Knife III * Chromoly Knife III * Cobalt Knife III * Iron Knife III * Titanium Knife III

The Knife II weapons available in-game are: * Cermet Knife II * Chrome Knife II * Chromoly Knife II * Iron Knife II

Landing a Whopper is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.6, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Piscinoids. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Late-Night Snack is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.9, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Purgovents. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Kiliran (Japanese: , Kiriran) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a Zaruboggan and can be found at the White Phosphor Lake in Cauldros during The Old Gods, where they ask the party to defeat the Xe-dom Sarto.

L's Shop is an accessible terminal in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found at the western end of Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, in an open-air market run by L. This console allows the player to add Augment slots to equipment in exchange for Miranium. The shop is opened after completing the Normal Mission Booming Business.

Knockback is a mobility debuff in . Knockback causes those inflicted with it to be pushed away from the source. It will interrupt the casting of Battle Arts. Some Battle Arts will inflict Knockback as a side-effect.
Lao's Legwear is Skell Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lao's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained anywhere else.
Lao's Bodywear is Skell Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lao's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Laserguns are back weapons for Skells in . They can be obtained from Balaenas or orange Pugiliths.
L-Missiles are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Hyper Rail Cannon type Seidrs, green Pugiliths.
Lao's Armwear L is Skell Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lao's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Lao's Armwear R is Skell Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lao's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
L-ARM-SPD2 is a Skell Wear arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Large Hooves are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Orluga in Eryth Sea, and also be traded for.

Last Stand (Japanese: , Rasuto Sutando) is one of Reyn's arts in . It activates an aura that allows Reyn to immediately recover his HP if he becomes incapacitated. Furthermore, 50% will be added to the Party Gauge after Reyn's HP recovery. In , Nene can use this art.

The Kingdom of Uraya (Japanese: , Invidia Retsu ōkoku, lit. The violent Kingdom of Invidia) is a Nation in . It is a force that rules from within the Urayan Titan. The capital is Fonsa Myma and Queen Raqura reigns over the nation. It stands on the brink of war with the Empire of Mor Ardain over territorial disputes. The Urayans deeply respect nature and have advanced biotechnology. A vast cave spreads throughout Uraya's body, and faint sunlight fills the place from the back of the Titan during the day. At night, the Saffronias emits pink and orange light, creating a beautiful shimmery scenery. __TOC__

Kynon is an NPC in . Kynon is a Gormotti who can be found near the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild. He offers the Merc Mission Port Pest Problem. Kynon works at the deck in Argentum. He likes taking time to play with his son and sending materials back to his homeland in Gormott.
Kynthia is an NPC in . Kynthia is a young Ardainian who can be found on the Goldmouth Exit Dock in the Argentum Trade Guild. Kynthia offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Krujah is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can initially be found in the Chairman's Room in the Argentum Trade Guild. Starting in Chapter 5, she moves to the Rumbletum Canteen. She is initially on good terms with her coworker Harghal, but develops resentment after they part ways in Chapter 5, setting up the events of Flames of Justice. She continues this rivalry after completion of this quest.
Kitoto is an NPC in . Kitoto is a Nopon who can be found at the Rumbletum Canteen in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. Kitoto runs a shop called Fishy Fishy specialized in Seafood.

Kokoi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found during the day at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild. She offers the Merc Mission Grounded Ship Rescue. Kokoi is a talkative Nopon who falls in love with many of the Drivers who pass by her inspection table. She often talks about how she would like to marry one someday but that she worries they'd be at an advantage with their Blades in marital disputes.

Kran Crustips (Japanese: , Kaningu Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 2 on the Salvage Deck and Goldmouth Exit Dock at the Argentum Trade Guild. This enemy drops no items.

The Kingdom of Torna (Japanese: , Īra ōkoku, lit. The Kingdom of Ira), sometimes referred to as Old Torna, was a Nation in , before it sank to the bottom of Alrest's Cloud Sea. It is the main setting for . Most inhabitants lived on the tail end of the Tornan Titan, and its capital, Auresco, was located on its back.
Knocked About Nopon is a quest in . It is received automatically when the party approaches Tunini between Garanti Plain and the Plains of Evening Calm in Gormott Province.

Kloom Farm (Japanese: , Kūramu Nōjō) is a location in . It is a set of fields located in Torigoth of Gormott Province, between Garagorm's Arch and the Torigoth Relay Base. Nomon grows his Nopopomouli here, and Pekka raises Arduns. The informal quest Ardun Rearing occurs here, and provides the only enemy in the area; the young Ardun in Pekka's field as it grows.
Lake Varna (Japanese: , Veruna-ko) is a location in . It is located in the Head of Uraya, between the Great Blowhole and Soulcrown Summit. There is a Treasure Trove here.
Kukurel Springwaters are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Café Savvy run by Adwen in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
The Knick-Knacks Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from Hobby Knick-Knacks in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

King Piranhax (Japanese: , Kingu Samon) are enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family and can be found at level 72-74 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly in the underground passage between Coolley Lake and Varnax's Plunge; or in Fonsa Myma Waters in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Lance Tirkin (Japanese: , Ransu Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 10-15 on Melnath's Shoulder or at Twin Trunks Hill in the Gormott Province. They can also be fought at level 99 during a Challenge Battle.

Kustal Sovereigns (Japanese: , Kusutiko Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Kustal-type members of the Sovereign family. They can be found at level 53-60 throughout the World Tree, such as below Mizar, Elevator #5. They can also be summoned at level 54 - 56 by Margot Sovereign, Mk. VI Margot, and Vaido Sovereign's art "Transfer Gate". Five of them must be defeated to unlock Dromarch's level 3 "Water Mastery", Theory's level 3 "Ice Mastery", Ursula's level 5 Beary-Go-Round and Nia's level 5 Merciful Heart.

Kux is an NPC in . Kux is a Phonex who can be found in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild, just to the south of the Central Exchange. Kux can only be spoken to if Nim is in the party with level 2 "Phonex Linguistics".

Krim Crustips (Japanese: , Kurimu Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family and can be found at level 20 - 22 at Farlaine Wells in the Kingdom of Uraya. Four must be defeated during the Quest True Colors to obtain a Crustip Chitin part.
Kroto is an NPC in . Kroto is a Leftherian who can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. Kroto runs a shop called Corcaja Greengrocers specialized in Veggies.
Larnea is an NPC in . Larnea is a Leftherian who can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. Larnea runs a shop called Talmye Antiques specialized in Art.
Lafda Blants (Japanese: , Rafuda Barando) are enemies in . They are members of the Blant family, and can be found at level 42 - 45 at the Toxbloom Spring on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Klim Anloods (Japanese: , Kurīmu Haindo) are enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 36-40 at the Litharia Snowfield and Sacred Ice Caverns on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal during the day. Two need to be defeated to unlock Corvin's Level 4 "Ictus".
Koror Skwarors (Japanese: , Koroera Sutora) are enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and can be found at level 38-40 at Hope's Horizon on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
